metagateway.rationale: MetaGateway proxy: punto de entrada unico que enruta queries a 5 sub-gateways especializados (media, code, infra, knowledge, shell) usando exact match + embeddings. Fail isolation entre dominios.

superpowers.rationale: Superpowers development workflow system: 14 skills (brainstorming, TDD, planning, code review, etc.) wrapped as MCP tools. Lazy-loaded, invoked only when needed via gateway.
